svg.title: Boundary mapping — coordinates, ownership and destination — window_block_c128_downsample_fp8
svg.desc: Direction-specific spatial boundary. Every highlighted pixel and lane has an explicit coordinate; the two layouts use different address formulas. Residual-only views are distinguished from main-input gathers.
svg.text: Boundary mapping — coordinates, ownership and destination
Pooling reads the raw Half result, before output quantization.
Read four raw high values at the orange coordinates; average them into low pixel (3,0).
The high skip is published separately. Its FP8 rounding must not replace the raw pooling input.
This entry then projects pooled C128→C256 and writes channel planes.
Low token count is 16 for the 8×8 high window; each low token still has its full channel vector.
Grid labels are actual pixel (x,y) coordinates relative to the selected window. Orange shows one complete spatial dependency.
